result.title: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
result.summary: Standard implementations of softmax, log-softmax, and cross-entropy have two numerical bugs. The first bug, Softmax Collapse, rounds the target logit's gradient to zero if that one logit is much larger than the others, resulting in gradients that no longer sum to zero. The second bug, Softmax Cancellation, occurs when student logits are close to teacher logits, and produces non-zero gradients even when the student and teacher logits are equal. We present simple implementations of log-softmax, softmax, and cross-entropy that fix both bugs. Our fix eliminates the previously-observed "Slingshot" phenomenon, speeds up grokking with weight decay, prevents accuracy collapse without weight decay, stops student networks from drifting away from the teacher during distillation, and shows that after memorization, logit growth is bounded by an equilibrium between weight decay and Adam's $ε$ hyperparameter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 softmax/log-softmax/cross-entropy 的两种数值缺陷：目标 logit 远大于其他 logit 时梯度被舍入为零（Softmax Collapse），以及师生 logit 接近时仍产生非零梯度（Softmax Cancellation），并给出修复实现，报告其消除「Slingshot」、加速 grokking、改善蒸馏中学生的漂移。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其对蒸馏梯度与 logit 增长的修正可能为 LVR 中轨迹蒸馏监督、长链训练稳定性提供实现层面的可核查线索。
